title: Good
text: Good. This table was all I wanted. Easy assembly, looks good and extension works. Regarding the chairs: assembly was a challenge because the angles of the slot inserts are somewhat random. Hence, it takes a lot of courage, muscle and finger tolerance. Also, you land up inserting the screw into the leg which does not have a predrilled hole for the screw! So there is a chance (thank God it did not happen to me) that you may crack the leg if you are not careful. Also, if you are 5' tall the back rest hits against the lower part of your shoulder blade on your back and so you need some kind of a padding or cushion. The leaf of the table fits into a drawer like slot under the table unit. This unit is 4.5" deep in comparison to the table rim being 2.5" deep. Therefore, the draw unit hurts the thighs of anyone who pulls the chair close, especially kids because they sit on an elevated chair/double cushion/child chair booster. I have altered my original review because of my experience over the last 12 months.
